The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Declines to call BlinkPay directly from the app or to hold the client ID and secret in the app
- Routes payment creation through the Django backend, which calls BlinkPay and returns only the redirect_uri
- States that the backend decides the amount and reference from the order record, not the app

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
